question: In ΔABC, O is the point of intersection of the bisectors of angle B and angle A. If the angle BOC = 108°, then angle BAO is:

In ΔABC, O is the point of intersection of the bisectors of ∠B and ∠A

∠BOC = 108° 

Concept used:

If the bisector of ∠ABC and ∠ACB of a triangle ABC meet at a point O then, ∠BOC = 90° + (1)/({2)} ∠A
